title: Executive / Assistant Manager | Finance Platform Solutions
description:
Join a collaborative, dynamic team shaping the future of finance technology at Macquarie. Finance Platform Solutions (FPS) delivers high\-quality, risk\-managed technology and data solutions that enable finance transformation at scale. You will partner with business, product, and technology teams to reimagine how we work, leveraging platforms such as Oracle Fusion and EPM to drive measurable outcomes, standardisation, and operational excellence.
   

  

 We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.
   

  

**What role will you play?**
 You’ll closely work with a senior Product Owner/Solutions Lead in shaping and delivering the product roadmap across Oracle Fusion finance and EPM modules translating strategic objectives into clear user stories and actionable release plans. The role focuses on process improvement, standardisation, and reducing manual effort by maintaining a prioritised product backlog and championing agile ways of working. You’ll collaborate with Finance, Tax, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities for enhancing ERP/EPM capabilities and design robust, end\-to\-end solutions with internal and external technology partners. Responsibilities include supporting release readiness, test planning, and business sign\-off to ensure alignment with controls and best practices to ensure consistency in process and platform usage.
   

  

**What You Offer**
* Degree in Accounting or Finance; professional qualification preferred.
* 5–7 years post\-qualification experience, ideally within Financial Services; familiarity with regulatory and statutory requirements is advantageous.
* Demonstrated experience with major finance platforms, preferably Oracle Fusion ERP and EPM (Fusion General Ledger, Accounting Hub, EDMCS, PCMCS, FCCS), with a sound understanding of ledger concepts.
* Proven stakeholder management skills across Business, Finance, Technology, Risk, and vendors; able to communicate complex issues simply and effectively.
* Experience contributing to product management activities (e.g., backlog management, user stories, release planning) and working in agile delivery environments.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset with a focus on continuous improvement, standardisation, and control.
* Ability to coordinate multiple assignments, operate in ambiguity, and work both independently and as part of cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency in MS Office; familiarity with data governance principles and control frameworks is beneficial.


 We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.
   

  

**What We Offer**
**Benefits**
 At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include:
   

  

* 1 wellbeing leave day per year
* 26 weeks’ paid maternity leave or 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of paid transition leave upon return to work and 6 weeks’ paid leave for secondary caregivers
* Company\-subsidised childcare services
* 2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching
* Benefits to support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing including comprehensive medical and life insurance cover, the option to join parental medical insurance plan and virtual medical consultations extended to family members
* Access to our Employee Assistance Program, a robust behavioural health network with counselling and coaching services
* Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription
* Hybrid and flexible working arrangements, dependent on role
* Reimbursement for work from home equipment


**About Financial Management, People and Engagement**
 Financial Management, People and Engagement (FPE) provides a single interface for Macquarie’s businesses across key areas of people, strategy, communications and financial management. Comprising two pillars – Financial Management, and People and Engagement – it is responsible for managing the Group’s financial, tax and treasury activities and strategic priorities, fostering our culture through people and community engagement strategies, and engaging with stakeholders to protect and promote Macquarie’s reputation globally.
   

  

**Inclusion at Macquarie**
 We are committed to providing an inclusive environment for all, where different experiences, skills and perspectives are valued and respected. Macquarie provides access to opportunities for all individuals regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, marital status, gender identity or any other characteristic or circumstance.
   

  

 We provide reasonable adjustments to individuals who may need support during the recruitment process and employment. If you require an adjustment, please let us know during the application process.

title: Analyst, Portfolio Valuation

The opportunity is ideal for professionals who are interested in learning global best practices, tools and techniques by working on valuation engagements for global clients.

* Minimum of 0\-2 years of valuation\-related work experience in financial services

title: Senior Analyst - Underwriting
description:
**Job Description**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 We are seeking for an analyst of commercial real estate experience to join a growing origination team in India. He/she will be responsible for supporting the team in all aspects of sourcing, structuring and closing multifamily and commercial real estate loans.
   

  

 Day\-to\-day responsibilities include providing financial, underwriting and market analysis to assist in the evaluation and processing of transactions. The analyst will command the details of various lending programs, including Freddie Mac and Fannie Mae.
   

  

**Essential Job Duties**
* Assist underwriters in end\-to\-end underwriting of US Commercial Real Estate loans across all the multi\-family deals.
* Include financial and cash flow Analysis, market information research, borrower level analysis, real estate documents analysis.
* Analyzing and interpret property performance through financial statements (operating statements and rent roll) and Real Estate Owned Schedules for different property types.
* Review and evaluate third party reports including real estate appraisals, environmental reports, property condition reports, zoning analysis etc. and maintain consistency among the reports.
* Requires advance knowledge of financial real estate terms. Basic understanding of approaches to value of real estate assets.
* Command in reviewing market reports like REIS and CoStar to understand prevailing demand\-supply, rents, and vacancy rates.
* Able to do the detailed narrative write\-up on complete scenario of the deal involving the property description, location summary, market details, cash flow notes and the borrower's summary.
* Running background credit search for Sponsors, Guarantors and Borrowers.
* Responsible for evaluating strengths, weaknesses and risks associated with the loan and preparing presentations for loan committee and management.
* Engaging the third parties for preparation of different types of reports mandated by the Lenders.
* Review \& underwrite loans ensuring compliance and maintaining the value proposition.
* Finding property value through underwriting process and completing loan analysis within specified TAT.
* Work closely with team to develop and pursue new relationships, and to provide exceptional service to existing clients of the firm.


**Skills, Education And Experience**
* Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Real Estate or other related fields.
* Ability to collaborate in a team environment.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Customer service focused.
* Ability to problem\-solve and exercise independent judgement while displaying a high degree of initiative and accuracy.
* Ability to organize and prioritize projects to complete multiple tasks on schedule.
* Technical skills: Advanced in Microsoft Office suite of applications, specifically excel and SharePoint.
* Strong work ethic and pro\-active team player able to work effectively under sometimes stressful conditions.

title: Manager / Assistant Vice President (AVP)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Investment Banking professional to join our Sell\-Side Investment Banking team, focused on helping companies raise capital and prepare for their next stage of growth.
   

  

 The role will primarily involve working with IPO\-bound, pre\-IPO and high\-growth companies on fundraising, capital structuring, investor positioning and transaction execution.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in investment banking, equity fundraising, IPO/pre\-IPO transactions, corporate finance, valuation and client acquisition, along with the ability to independently manage relationships with promoters, founders, investors and other transaction stakeholders.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Origination \& Client Acquisition
* Identify and develop relationships with companies that are potential pre\-IPO or IPO candidates.
* Source new mandates through promoter/founder relationships, professional networks, intermediaries and industry relationships.
* Develop a strong pipeline of potential fundraising and IPO mandates.
* Understand the company’s business, capital requirements, growth plans and fundraising objectives.
* Pitch and present investment banking solutions to promoters, founders and senior management.
* Fundraising \& Transaction Execution
* Lead and support equity fundraising transactions, including pre\-IPO/private placements and other structured equity transactions.
* Work with companies to determine appropriate fundraising size, valuation, transaction structure and investor positioning.
* Coordinate the complete transaction process from mandate acquisition through successful closure.
* Prepare transaction timelines, investor lists, deal structures and execution plans.
* Coordinate with legal, secretarial, accounting, merchant banking, due\-diligence and other professional advisors.
* IPO \& Pre\-IPO Advisory
* Evaluate companies for IPO readiness and identify gaps that need to be addressed before listing.
* Assist companies in developing an appropriate roadmap from private/pre\-IPO stage to IPO.
* Work closely with management on business positioning, equity story and investor communication.
* Support preparation of investor presentations, information memoranda, financial analysis and other transaction\-related materials.
* Assist in valuation analysis and benchmarking against listed and comparable companies.
* Investor \& Institutional Relationships
* Develop and maintain relationships with HNI, family office, institutional and strategic investors.
* Build and maintain an investor database across sectors.
* Match suitable companies and transactions with relevant investors.
* Coordinate investor meetings, management presentations, conference calls and due\-diligence discussions.
* Understand investor requirements and communicate transaction opportunities effectively.
* Financial Analysis \& Valuation
* Build and review financial models, projections and valuation analyses.
* Conduct comparable\-company, precedent\-transaction and other relevant valuation analyses.
* Analyse financial statements, business performance, growth prospects and key operating metrics.
* Assist management in understanding valuation expectations and capital\-market positioning.
* Deal Management
* Take ownership of assigned mandates and ensure timely execution.
* Manage multiple transactions simultaneously and maintain transaction trackers.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external advisors throughout the transaction lifecycle.
* Identify transaction risks, bottlenecks and execution issues and proactively resolve them.
* Maintain high standards of confidentiality and transaction discipline.


 Business Development Expectations
   

  

 For the Manager/AVP level, this is not intended to be a purely execution\-oriented role.
   

  

**The Candidate Will Be Expected To**
* Build a meaningful company/promoter pipeline.
* Develop independent relationships with founders, promoters and senior management.
* Generate new investment\-banking mandates.
* Convert opportunities into signed mandates and successfully executed transactions.
* Build long\-term relationships with companies beyond a single fundraising transaction.


 Key Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Strong understanding of Investment Banking and Sell\-Side transactions.
* Experience in equity fundraising, pre\-IPO, IPO or corporate finance.
* Strong financial modelling and valuation skills.
* Excellent understanding of financial statements and capital structures.
* Strong business\-development and relationship\-management capabilities.
* Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Ability to interact confidently with promoters, CXOs, investors and senior stakeholders.
* Strong transaction\-management and execution capabilities.
* Ability to work independently in a high\-growth, entrepreneurial environment.


**Preferred Background**
 Candidates from the following backgrounds would be relevant:
   

  

* Investment Banking
* CFA (Mandatory)
* Equity Capital Markets
* Merchant Banking
* Corporate Finance
* M\&A / Transaction Advisory
* Private Equity / Venture Capital with strong transaction exposure
* Big 4 Transaction Advisory / Deals
* Securities / Capital Markets


 Experience specifically involving IPO, pre\-IPO or equity fundraising transactions will be an advantage.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 The successful candidate will be expected to build and manage a strong pipeline of IPO\-bound and pre\-IPO companies, originate high\-quality mandates, execute fundraising transactions efficiently and develop long\-term relationships with promoters and investors.
   

  

 In short: Originate → Advise → Structure → Raise Capital → Execute → Build Long\-Term Client Relationships.
   

  

 Skills: management,investment banking,capital,ipo,pre\-ipo,investors

**Job Description:**
**ROLE PURPOSE:**
 As Market Access Manager, you will be responsible for enabling access across the company’s portfolio by developing and implementing market access strategies that address pricing, reimbursement, funding pathways, policy shaping, and stakeholder engagement. The role will support portfolio\-wide access objectives across relevant therapeutic areas, with a specific focus on public accounts, national and sub\-national health authorities, public procurement bodies, and public health programs. Your work will help ensure timely, sustainable, and equitable access to medicines and vaccines by aligning evidence, value communication, and partnership strategies with public\-sector priorities and patient needs.
   

  

**ACCOUNTABILITIES:**
**Portfolio Market Access Strategy:** 
 Develop and execute integrated market access strategies across the portfolio, ensuring each product has a clear access pathway that reflects its value proposition, patient need, public health relevance, affordability considerations, and local healthcare system dynamics.
 **Evidence Generation and Value Demonstration:** 
 Collaborate with medical, HEOR, policy, and cross\-functional teams to generate and translate evidence that demonstrates clinical, economic, budgetary, and public health value across the portfolio, supporting access discussions with public stakeholders and payers.
 **Pricing, Reimbursement, and Funding Pathways:** 
 Support pricing and reimbursement strategies by analyzing market dynamics, public funding mechanisms, procurement models, affordability barriers, and competitor benchmarks, while ensuring alignment with portfolio value, patient access objectives, and compliance requirements.
 **Public Account Engagement:** 
 Build and maintain strategic relationships with public accounts, including government health authorities, public payers, national and sub\-national institutions, procurement agencies, public hospitals, and public health program stakeholders, to understand priorities and shape sustainable access solutions.
 **Value Communication:** 
 Communicate product and portfolio value propositions to policymakers, public payers, procurement stakeholders, healthcare providers, and internal teams, clearly articulating clinical value, public health impact, economic considerations, and relevance to public\-sector priorities.
 **Public Market Intelligence:** 
 Monitor healthcare policy, public funding priorities, reimbursement trends, procurement processes, tender opportunities, competitor activity, and stakeholder dynamics to identify access opportunities, risks, and implications for the portfolio.
 **Access Planning and Execution:** 
 Partner with cross\-functional teams to integrate market access considerations into brand planning, launch planning, lifecycle management, reimbursement planning, public account plans, and private\-channel access initiatives, ensuring timely execution of activities that support access across the portfolio.
 **Compliance:** 
**and Governance:** 
**:** 
 Ensure all market access and public account activities comply with applicable laws, regulations, internal policies, and ethical standards, maintaining transparency and integrity in all interactions with external stakeholders.
   

  

**Critical leadership capabilities:**
 As a Market Access Manager responsible for portfolio\-wide access with a focus on public accounts, strong leadership capabilities are essential to navigate complex healthcare systems, align internal and external stakeholders, and deliver sustainable access outcomes. The following capabilities are critical for success in this role
   

  

**Strategic Vision:** 
 A Market Access Manager should have a clear and compelling strategic vision for market access initiatives. They must be able to align with the organization's overall goals and craft a well\-defined roadmap to achieve market access objectives.

**Stakeholder Engagement:** 
 Building and maintaining trusted relationships with public\-sector stakeholders, including government officials, public payers, procurement bodies, health authorities, HTA bodies, and healthcare institutions, is crucial to advancing access priorities across the portfolio.
 **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 
 Market access initiatives require close collaboration with commercial, medical, regulatory, policy, legal, compliance, supply, and finance teams. The Market Access Manager should foster alignment across functions to support portfolio planning, public account execution, and sustainable access outcomes.
   

  

**Adaptability:** 
 The healthcare landscape and regulatory environment can be dynamic and unpredictable. Effective leaders in market access must be adaptable to changes, able to navigate challenges, and pivot strategies as needed to achieve objectives.
   

  

**Data\-Driven Decision Making:** 
 A successful Market Access Manager relies on data\-driven insights to support their decisions. This includes analyzing health economic data, market trends, competitor analysis, and real\-world evidence to shape pricing and access strategies.
   

  

**Ethical and Compliance Orientation:** 
 Market access involves engaging with public health stakeholders, and ethical conduct is critical. A Market Access Manager should uphold high ethical standards and ensure compliance with relevant laws and regulations throughout all interactions.
   

  

**Resilience:** 
 Achieving market access for a new vaccine can be a complex and demanding process, often requiring persistence and resilience. A strong leader in this role remains focused, positive, and determined in overcoming obstacles and achieving objectives.
   

  

**Innovative:** 
**Access:** 
**Thinking:** 
 Public\-sector access may require innovative approaches to address affordability, funding, procurement, and implementation barriers. A capable leader should identify practical solutions and partnership models that improve access while supporting long\-term portfolio sustainability.
   

  

**Results\-Oriented:** 
 Setting clear goals and objectives is essential, and a Market Access Manager should be results\-oriented, ensuring the team remains focused on achieving measurable outcomes in terms of pricing, reimbursement, and access.

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
**Job Title: E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Growth Manager** 




  





 We are looking for a highly driven and commercially minded
 **E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Growth Manager** 
 to take ownership of our online sales channels and drive growth across marketplaces, our website, and other digital commerce platforms.
 



  





 This is not a purely operational role. We are looking for someone who can think like a business owner—someone who can identify opportunities, improve sales, optimise profitability, study competitors, develop new product ideas, and build new revenue channels.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will manage and grow our presence across platforms such as
 **Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, our own website, and other relevant marketplaces and aggregator portals** 
 .
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Marketplace Management \& Growth** 



* Manage and grow sales across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and other relevant e\-commerce and aggregator platforms.
* Create, optimise and manage product listings, including titles, descriptions, keywords, images and product information.
* Monitor product performance and identify opportunities to improve sales and visibility.
* Plan and execute pricing, discounts, offers, bundles and promotional campaigns.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure inventory availability and minimise stock\-outs.
* Monitor product ratings, reviews, returns and customer feedback.
* Identify underperforming SKUs and develop strategies to improve or discontinue them.
* Identify high\-performing products and opportunities to scale them.



  





**2\. Website Sales \& Digital Commerce Growth** 



* Drive sales and growth through the company website.
* Identify opportunities to improve website conversion rates and customer experience.
* Create product bundles, combo offers, trial packs, family packs, premium packs and other initiatives to increase average order value.
* Develop cross\-selling and upselling opportunities across the product portfolio.
* Work with internal and external teams to improve product pages, offers and customer journeys.
* Develop strategies to increase repeat purchases and customer retention.



  





**3\. Customer Feedback, Testimonials \& Retention** 



* Develop and manage a structured process for collecting customer feedback.
* Conduct customer calls to understand product experience and satisfaction.
* Identify satisfied customers and collect written and video testimonials.
* Build a strong repository of customer reviews, testimonials and user\-generated content for use across digital platforms.
* Follow up with customers to encourage repeat purchases and referrals.
* Analyse customer complaints and feedback to identify opportunities for product and service improvement.



  





**4\. Competitor Research \& Pricing Strategy** 



* Continuously monitor competitors, their products, pricing, offers and promotions.
* Conduct regular market research to identify trending products and emerging opportunities.
* Identify products that competitors are selling successfully and evaluate whether they can be developed, manufactured or sourced in\-house.
* Work with internal teams to identify opportunities for competitive pricing while maintaining healthy margins.
* Prepare regular competitor and market intelligence reports for management.



  





**5\. New Product \& Revenue Opportunities** 



* Identify new product categories and opportunities that can generate additional revenue.
* Research products currently performing well in the market and assess their commercial potential.
* Identify opportunities to manufacture, source or develop products at competitive pricing.
* Work with internal teams to develop new SKUs, variants, sizes, bundles and product extensions.
* Explore high\-margin complementary products and add\-on opportunities.
* Present commercially viable new product and revenue ideas to management on a regular basis.



  





**6\. New Digital Sales Channels** 



* Identify and onboard relevant e\-commerce platforms, aggregator portals and other digital sales channels.
* Explore opportunities for affiliate marketing, referral programs and micro\-influencer partnerships.
* Develop strategies to increase direct\-to\-consumer sales and reduce dependency on any single marketplace.
* Identify potential opportunities in bulk orders, corporate sales, gifting and B2B partnerships where relevant.



  





**7\. Sales, Data \& Profitability** 



* Track daily, weekly and monthly sales performance across all channels.
* Monitor profitability at a product and channel level.
* Analyse the impact of discounts, commissions, returns and promotional campaigns on margins.
* Identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve profitability.
* Prepare regular MIS and growth reports for management.
* Take ownership of assigned revenue and growth targets.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* Proven experience in managing e\-commerce marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of online product listings, pricing, promotions and marketplace operations.
* Commercial mindset with the ability to identify new sales and revenue opportunities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to understand product profitability, margins and pricing.
* Experience with website sales and D2C e\-commerce will be an advantage.
* Comfortable speaking with customers and conducting feedback or testimonial calls.
* Ability to conduct competitor and market research.
* Highly proactive, organised and result\-oriented.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of business outcomes.



  





**Preferred Profile** 




 We would prefer someone who:
 


* Has hands\-on experience managing multiple e\-commerce platforms.
* Understands both
 **sales growth and profitability** 
 .
* Can independently identify problems and propose solutions.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced and entrepreneurial environment.
* Has a strong interest in consumer products, digital commerce and new product development.
* Thinks beyond day\-to\-day operations and actively looks for new business opportunities.

title: Asia Pacific Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 This position is an integral part of the Asia\-Pacific (AP) Regional Finance Team and works very closely with our regional Specialty Business Units (SBUs), particularly TDA and Platinion business and leadership. The role primarily provides business partnering support to Platinion in the areas of commercial, analysis, decision support, planning, closing review and reporting. It could evolve into further SBU financial support over time.
   

  

 This position is built around teamwork and meeting customer needs which provides the opportunity to work with senior stakeholders in the AP region. The role teams with the local Finance teams, other regional and cross\-functional teams, and the global Finance community. The individual must be a team player and capable of working flexibly, virtually and across different cultures.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Platinion business finance support
* Developing and presenting insightful financial analysis for Platinion and regional leadership to support business decisions; both recurring weekly / monthly reporting as well as ad\-hoc analysis and reporting as required
* Providing in\-depth commercial support to Platinion involved cases, such as, but not limited to evaluating pricing of projects, and its implications on Platinion financials, along with project end\-to\-end management and keeping track of estimated project position to avoid surprises on any overruns/premium adjustment etc
* Supporting the plan and estimate processes for the Platinion business covering financial modelling, capacity planning, revenue projections, reporting and functional cost estimates as well as the preparation of related presentations
* Monitoring and analysing performance against plan and pro\-actively highlighting issues and opportunities for improvements (including but not restricted to revenue, capacity, billability, staffing\- and pricing trends)
* Responsible for the monthly and annual closing of Platinion AP books in coordination with Global Accounting \& Control and local offices.


**Functional Practice Finance Support**
* Supporting the Planning, analysis and reporting on broader functional areas for the TDA Practice Area in AP
* Supporting the coordination and alignment of Platinion reporting units across BCG with other regions, the global team and TDA Practice Area


**AP Regional Finance support**
* Acting as back\-up to the other AP Regional Finance team members as required
* Supporting the broader global finance function in its transformation efforts including roll\-out of new systems, policies, processes, and initiatives.
* Providing support to \& sharing best practices with local Finance teams as required
* Building networks with other regional finance teams, liaising with Global services, Global finance and other Regional Functions as required


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Accounting or Finance
* Work experience:
* Internal: Significant experience in BCG Finance preferred, with deep knowledge of BCG accounting, planning, commercial and systems
* External: of around 5\-10 years in handling the Finance planning \& analysis, commercial \& stakeholder management. Experience in service industry and more specifically consulting firms preferred
* Advanced computer literacy:
* Strong knowledge of Oracle Financial Systems, HFM, FIM and BCG’s BIR tool preferred. SAP experience helpful
* At minimum, strong Excel skills required. Affinity with more advanced analytics tools like Tableau \& Power BI is a preference
* Strong knowledge of PowerPoint slide writing with familiarity with Thinkcell preferred
* Strong business sense, working knowledge of BCG commercial process \& working knowledge of US GAAP accounting standards
* Good analytical skills with an attention to detail and an ability to look at data in different ways while also being able to see the bigger picture
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills and ability to operate effectively in a virtual team and a global environment through establishing positive and productive working relationships (self\-motivated, responsive, service oriented)
* Proven ability to plan work effectively and prioritize work, even in stressful situations


 Additional info
   

  

 At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
   

  

 For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
   

  

 We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

 Interpath Advisory is an international and fast\-growing advisory business with expertise across deals, advisory and restructuring.

* Build the underlying financial analysis on which the team's conclusions rest, covering trading performance, margins and other key measures
* Prepare working capital, net debt and other supporting schedules and exhibits

* Prepare tables and charts for the report to the standard the team requires
* Maintain the information request list and flag items that have not been received
* Support the question\-and\-answer process and help prepare for management meetings
* Address review points properly, resolving the underlying issue rather than the symptom


**What We Are Looking For**
* Qualified accountant or finalist — CA (ICAI), CA (SA), ACA, ACCA or equivalent OR MBA in Finance or equivalent.
* Around 3 to 5 years of experience, of which at least 2 in financial due diligence, or in audit with genuine deals exposure
* Strong Excel skills. Accuracy under time pressure is central to the role
* Understands the purpose of a quality of earnings analysis, not only the mechanics of preparing one
* Clear written English
* Responds constructively to review and acts on the feedback given


**What Would Also Help**
* Big Four audit or transaction services background
* Exposure to MS Excel, Alteryx, Power Query or Power BI
* CFA Level I or progress towards it
* Experience working to UK or European reporting conventions


**How We Will Assess You**
 A screening call, a technical interview, a case study, and a conversation with the Transaction Services lead you will be working with. We will tell you where you stand after each stage.
   

  

**Our Values:**
**Embrace different: \-** 
 From cultures to mindsets, we welcome them all. Our global presence means we're inclusive by nature and we believe that people are equal, but not the same.
   

  

**Do the right thing:** 
 \- Our comfort zone is uncomfortable; we always make the right decision not what is simply easy or popular. Always consider how to implement these decisions, people will always remember how you made them feel.
   

  

**All hands on deck:** 
 \- We stand shoulder to shoulder with colleagues and clients, be that physically or from afar. Our individual expertise may find them answers, but it is through teamwork that it is implemented.
   

  

**Passion drives success:** 
 \- The impossible is always possible, we push the boundaries of what is expected because we're never satisfied with the status quo. Our clients expect a positive result when they engage with us, and it's only by delivering this that we win.
   

  

**Benefits**
****Benefits****
* Opportunity to grow within a fast\-paced global organisation and build deep expertise in M\&A integration
* Direct exposure to senior leadership and executive management
* Competitive salary package, aligned with experience and market standards
* International exposure, working with multicultural teams across multiple regions

description:

* Manage the information request and question\-and\-answer process, following up on outstanding items and escalating where information is not forthcoming

* Sell\-side as well as buy\-side experience
* Alteryx, Power Query or Power BI
* Exposure to UK or European deal processes

 A screening call, a technical interview, a case study, and a conversation with the Transaction Services lead you will be working with. We will tell you where you stand after each stage.
   

  

**Our Values:**
**Embrace different: \-** 
 From cultures to mindsets, we welcome them all. Our global presence means we're inclusive by nature and we believe that people are equal, but not the same.
   

  

**Do the right thing:** 
 \- Our comfort zone is uncomfortable; we always make the right decision not what is simply easy or popular. Always consider how to implement these decisions, people will always remember how you made them feel.
   

  

**All hands on deck:** 
 \- We stand shoulder to shoulder with colleagues and clients, be that physically or from afar. Our individual expertise may find them answers, but it is through teamwork that it is implemented.
   

  

**Passion drives success:** 
 \- The impossible is always possible, we push the boundaries of what is expected because we're never satisfied with the status quo. Our clients expect a positive result when they engage with us, and it's only by delivering this that we win.
   

  

**Benefits**
****Benefits****
* Opportunity to grow within a fast\-paced global organisation and build deep expertise in M\&A integration
* Direct exposure to senior leadership and executive management
* Competitive salary package, aligned with experience and market standards
* International exposure, working with multicultural teams across multiple regions

**Job Description:**
 Lead/Assistant Manager – ICFR (Business Controls)
   

  

 Location: Sector\- 62, Gurugram
   

  

 Shift timings: 3:30 pm\- 12 am
   

  

 Mode: Hybrid
   

  

 Department: ICFR
   

  

 Reports To: Associate Director
   

  

**Position Overview**
 The Financial Control Analyst – ICFR (2nd Line of Defense) plays a vital role in validating the integrity of Sun Life’s financial and actuarial processes, and external reporting. Reporting to the Director, ICFR in the Financial Controls department, this role supports management and assurance activities by evaluating the design and operating effectiveness of key financial and actuarial controls, which underpin CEO/CFO certifications and regulatory compliance requirements.
   

  

 The analyst partners with Finance, Actuarial, and underlying Operational process owners and external auditors to plan and execute control walkthroughs, testing, and deficiency evaluation. The position offers broad exposure to ICFR across the end\-to\-end financial close and actuarial reporting lifecycle and provides meaningful opportunities to deepen expertise in financial and actuarial control frameworks within a digitally transforming organization.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Execute ICFR Control Evaluation Program
   

  

* Coordinate and lead internal control walkthroughs with Finance, Actuarial, and Operational process owners (and external auditors as applicable) to confirm process understanding, key risks, and control points across the end\-to\-end lifecycle.
* Perform testing of operational, financial close, and actuarial reporting controls (e.g., policy set\-up, data activity reviews, reconciliations, journal entry controls, management review controls, reserve review controls, and assumption governance) in accordance with professional audit standards and established deadlines.
* Evaluate control deficiencies, support root cause analysis, and perform remediation validation testing to confirm corrective actions are effectively implemented.


 Support Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Assess control effectiveness across operational processes, the financial close, and actuarial reporting; identify gaps and opportunities to strengthen the control environment.
* Partner with process and control owners to enhance the sustainability of controls through clearer procedures, evidence standards, and consistent execution across the close and actuarial reporting cycle.
* Remain informed about emerging risks, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices relevant to ICFR, financial reporting, and actuarial governance.


 Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement
   

  

* Liaise with external auditors to coordinate walkthroughs, testing, and evidence requests related to operational, financial close, and actuarial reporting controls.
* Build strong working relationships with cross\-functional stakeholders across Operations, Finance, and Actuarial to drive timely walkthroughs, testing, and issue resolution.
* Communicate testing results, deficiencies, and observations clearly and professionally to team management, including recommended remediation actions.


 Quality and Professional Development
   

  

* Maintain high standards for walkthrough and testing documentation, including clear testing narratives, risk/control mappings, and sufficient audit evidence.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing and standardization of walkthrough and testing approaches for operational, financial close, and actuarial reporting controls.
* Proactively develop technical and professional skills in financial and actuarial control evaluation, including ICFR requirements, deficiency evaluation, and effective remediation practices.


**What You Bring**
 Required Qualifications
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* CA, CPA, CISA, or progress toward a relevant professional certification.
* Typically, 2\.5\- 8 years of experience in audit, controls, or risk management, with exposure to ICFR/SOX environments.
* Public accounting experience is strongly preferred.


 Technical Knowledge
   

  

* Working knowledge of ICFR/SOX and COSO frameworks.
* Familiarity with control walkthroughs, testing techniques, and audit documentation standards.


 Core Skills
   

  

* Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze control designs, identify risks, and assess operating effectiveness.
* Communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain control concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Execution Focus: Strong attention to detail, ability to manage multiple testing activities, and meet deadlines in a structured environment.
* Collaboration: Comfortable working as part of a team and engaging constructively with stakeholders at various levels.


 Valued Assets
   

  

* Experience in insurance, financial services, or other regulated industries.
* Experience with actuarial concepts and evaluating actuarial internal controls.
* Prior experience supporting external audit engagements.

description:
We are seeking a Senior Accountant to join our Accounting Services practice. This role will be responsible for managing the month\-end and annual close and consolidation process for our clients. The ideal candidate will have at least 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in finance and accounting operations and a strong understanding of key accounting principles. This position offers the opportunity to help build and standardize accounting practices across a growing client base in the U.S. The Senior Accountant will play a key role in driving process improvements and supporting our clients’ financial operations. Candidate is a self\-starter who has a very strong understanding of the P\&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow transactions, and with a deep understanding of financial systems.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, supporting the implementation and optimization of financial systems (e.g., General Ledger, billing, T\&E, AP procurement).
* Prepare monthly and annual financial close and consolidation processes for multiple clients.
* Prepare and post journal entries; manage general ledger activity and reconcile key accounts (bank, cash, prepaid expenses, fixed assets, etc.).
* Support payroll and deduction entries; oversee accounts payable and receivable, invoicing, and revenue recognition.
* Prepare accurate and timely financial statements, including P\&L, balance sheet, and cash flow reports.
* Provide guidance on technical accounting matters, ensuring compliance with US GAAP or IFRS as applicable.
* Apply sound judgment in navigating differences between GAAP and IFRS, especially in areas such as revenue recognition, asset treatment, and expense recognition.
* Support financial audits by preparing required documentation and working with external auditors.
* Partner with client leadership on budgeting, FP\&A, and special projects, including cash flow forecasting and business analytics.
* Liaise with client\-side banks, vendors, and third\-party partners.
* Contribute to building standardized processes and best practices across consulting engagements.



  





**Requirements:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Commerce; CPA or CA certification required
* Minimum 3 years of relevant accounting experience
* Experience with GAAP and/or IFRS standards required
* Strong understanding of financial statements and core accounting principles
* Experience with Workday or similar ERP systems is a strong plus
* Proficiency in accounting software, Microsoft Excel, and G Suite products
* Highly detail\-oriented with strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent organizational and written/verbal communication abilities

title: Growth & Performance Manager || D2C brands ||2+years || Gurugram || upto 23 LPA
description:
Growth \& Performance Manager
 



 2\+years experience
 



 D2C brands, Early startup Quick commerce
 



 Gurugram
 



 CTC upto 23 LPA
 



  





 THE ROLE
 



 We are looking for a highly analytical, commercially minded and execution\-focused Growth \& Performance Manager to improve how the company acquires, activates, retains and grows customers. This is not a reporting\-only role: you will connect marketing spend, app behaviour, orders, cohorts and retention data to identify funnel gaps and investment opportunities, working closely with founders and cross\-functional teams.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



 • Performance \& funnel measurement: Track CAC, CPA, ROAS, CTR, conversion, AOV, contribution, repeat rate and LTV; analyse the journey from install to repeat purchase.
 



 • Campaign optimisation \& experiments: Evaluate audiences, creatives, offers, landing pages and channel mix across Meta, Google and emerging channels; run A/B tests.
 



 • Retention \& lifecycle: Support customer segmentation and journeys across WhatsApp, push, email and in\-app communication to improve engagement and repeat behaviour.
 



 • Dashboards \& forecasting: Build weekly dashboards and forward\-looking forecasts for spend, orders, revenue and customer metrics.
 



 • New growth levers: Assess referrals, affiliates, creators, partnerships, communities and offline\-to\-online activations based on ROI and acquisition quality.
 



 • Tracking \& data quality: Strengthen UTMs, event tracking, attribution and reporting across the app, CRM and advertising platforms.
 



  





 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



 • 2\-4 years of experience in growth analytics, performance marketing, business analytics, lifecycle marketing or user growth.
 



 • Experience in quick commerce, grocery, FMCG, D2C, e\-commerce, consumer apps or another high\-frequency category is strongly preferred.
 



 • Strong command of Excel/Google Sheets and working knowledge of SQL; exposure to Power BI, Tableau or Looker Studio is preferred.
 



 • Hands\-on understanding of Meta Ads, Google Ads, CAC, ROAS, LTV, cohorts, funnels and retention; exposure to GA4, GTM, MMPs and CRM tools is a plus.
 



 • Strong academic background; Tier\-1 education preferred, with the ability to turn complex data into clear commercial recommendations.
 



 • High ownership, attention to detail and comfort in an early\-stage environment; based in Gurugram or willing to relocate and work from the office.

title: Finance Manager, Trilogy (Remote) - $100,000/year USD
description:
Most finance managers gradually stop doing finance. Their calendars fill with status meetings, task chasing, and people administration while their technical skills go stale. This role takes the opposite path.
   

  

 You will run global finance operations through a team of Senior Accountants while staying close enough to the work to know whether it is actually right. You'll inspect invoices, payments, reconciliations, allocations, and other finance outputs; diagnose the accounting or process failures behind errors; and turn those findings into written coaching that prevents the same mistakes from happening again. When a critical deadline or difficult finance problem demands it, you will still be capable of getting hands\-on yourself.
   

  

 Trilogy's Central Finance team operates differently from a traditional accounting organization. We automate routine coordination and continuously look for ways AI and automation can eliminate manual work, leaving finance professionals focused on judgment, quality, and improvement. You'll get exposure to complex global finance operations while retaining the technical edge that many managers lose as they advance. If you want management responsibility without becoming a professional meeting\-attendee, this is where your accounting expertise becomes leverage.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Keep finance operations moving through Senior Accountants, continuously prioritizing work based on deadlines, business impact, dependencies, and financial risk.
* Inspect finance dashboards and completed work to ensure bills, invoices, payments, bank transactions, reconciliations, control accounts, revenue, and spend allocations are accurate and current.
* Diagnose quality failures using your own accounting expertise, identifying whether the root cause is incorrect data, system configuration, accounting treatment, or process execution.
* Write evidence\-based coaching that explains what went wrong, how to correct it, and how to prevent it from happening again.
* Identify opportunities to use AI, LLMs, and automation to eliminate manual work and improve the speed and accuracy of finance operations.


**What You Won’t Be Doing**
* Spending your week chasing status updates, assigning routine tasks, or sitting in project\-management meetings.
* Personally processing every transaction because delegating is easier than developing a strong accounting team.
* Giving generic performance feedback disconnected from actual invoices, payments, reconciliations, reports, or other finance outputs.
* Accepting recurring errors and inefficient manual processes as “just how finance works.”


**Finance Manager Key Responsibilities**
 Build a high\-performing finance operations team that consistently produces accurate, timely finance deliverables while continuously improving quality and reducing unnecessary manual work.
   

  

**Basic Requirements**
* A degree in Accounting or Finance.
* A recognized professional accounting qualification such as CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent.
* Experience on at least five audits involving a Big 4 accounting firm, either as the auditor or the client.
* Accounting or finance experience within an organization with at least $100M USD in revenue.
* People\-management experience with direct responsibility for finance or accounting professionals.
* Hands\-on experience across AP, AR/customer invoicing, bank and control\-account reconciliations, and revenue and spend allocation.
* Experience prioritizing and allocating operational finance work across a team while managing deadlines and resolving blockers.
* Experience embedding AI or LLM tools into a recurring, high\-volume finance transaction\-processing workflow, beyond ad hoc prompting or reporting\-only analysis, with a clear impact on efficiency or accuracy.
* Ability to work US business hours.


**Nice\-to\-have Requirements**
* Experience designing or building finance workflow automations using tools such as n8n, Lovable, Claude Code, or similar platforms.
* Experience managing finance operations across multiple business lines or international entities.


**About Trilogy**
 Hundreds of software businesses run on the Trilogy Business Platform. For three decades, Trilogy has been known for 3 things: Relentlessly seeking top talent, innovating new technology, and incubating new businesses.
   

  

 Our technological innovation is spearheaded by a passion for simple customer\-facing designs. Our incubation of new businesses ranges from entirely new moon\-shot ideas to rearchitecting existing projects for today's modern cloud\-based stack.
   

  

 Trilogy is a place where you can be surrounded with great people, be proud of doing great work, and grow your career in leaps and bounds.
   

  

 There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!
   

  

**Working with us**
 This is a full\-time (40 hours per week), long\-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $50 USD/hour, which equates to $100,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Consult www.crossover.com/help\-and\-faqs for more details on this topic.

title: Commercial Pricing Analyst

 As a Commercial Pricing Analyst at TMS Global, part of DS Smith, you'll play a key role in supporting profitable growth across a diverse international customer portfolio. Working with stakeholders across EMEA, APAC, LATAM and North America, you'll transform complex commercial data into actionable insights, influence pricing strategy and support critical decision\-making that drives business performance and long\-term customer value.

title: Senior Associate - Consumer & Retail Consulting
description:
**Job Title: Senior Associate \- Consumer \& Retail Consulting** 




  





 Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India

**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal is a global professional services firm helping organizations tackle complex business issues, improve operating performance and maximize stakeholder value. Founded in 1983, A\&M is known for practical, action\-oriented advisory, business performance improvement, turnaround management and interim leadership services across industries and geographies. Its professionals combine independent thinking, deep expertise and an operator mindset to deliver measurable results for clients. The India Global Capability Center partners with A\&M leadership and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, supporting end\-to\-end client delivery, thought leadership, digital enablement and analytics. The Consumer and Retail Group works with companies across consumer products and retail to address disruption, strengthen performance and create growth. A\&M’s culture is guided by integrity, quality, objectivity, fun, personal reward and inclusive diversity, with founding principles centered on leadership, action and results.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a Senior Associate in the Consumer \& Retail Group, you will own medium\-to\-complex workstreams across corporate transformation and performance improvement engagements. You will translate ambiguous client questions and operational data into fact\-based insights, practical recommendations and measurable actions across consumer products and retail. Working in a flat team with Managers, Directors and senior clients, you will lead analyses, manage key stakeholder relationships and help deliver outcomes across market assessment, growth strategy, supply chain, pricing, merchandising, store operations and financial performance. The role combines analytical depth with commercial judgment, clear communication and hands\-on execution. You will also contribute to pitches, thought leadership, capability building and mentoring, while working onsite from Gurgaon and remaining open to business travel and potential future relocation within the India capability center.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own medium\-to\-complex workstreams from problem definition through client\-ready output, using structured analysis to identify performance gaps and convert findings into practical transformation actions.
* Develop Consumer and Retail solutions across consumer products and retail sectors, connecting market, operational and financial metrics to growth strategy, value creation and improved client performance.
* Analyze and benchmark data across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations to surface underperformance and prioritize interventions.
* Lead client and internal stakeholder interactions by clarifying requirements, communicating insights and explaining business impact to senior CRG clients, A\&M leaders and third parties.
* Build accurate models, dashboards and presentations using Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx or Python to support timely decisions and zero\-defect deliverables.
* Manage milestones, dependencies and competing priorities under pressure, while collaborating with team members to deliver agreed outputs and maintain momentum across projects.
* Support A\&M growth through pitch development, marketing, innovative offering development, recruiting, training and mentoring Analysts and Associates.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Strong Consumer Products and Retail expertise, including sector data and metrics across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations.
* Demonstrated experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or transformation, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and deliver fact\-based recommendations that influence client decisions.
* Advanced Excel modelling and analytical skills, including organizing complex data to draw conclusions, test scenarios and support timely operational and financial decision\-making.
* Strong PowerPoint capability, with a track record of creating clear, persuasive and defect\-free presentations for senior clients, leadership teams and business development discussions.
* Working proficiency in Power BI or Tableau for data visualization and Alteryx or Python for data analysis, with the judgment to select appropriate tools for each problem.
* Excellent written, verbal, research and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate difficult messages with integrity and explain analytical impact to varied stakeholders.
* Practical leadership, prioritization and teamwork skills, including mentoring junior colleagues, motivating teams and delivering high\-quality work in pressured environments.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience across multiple Consumer Products or Retail subsectors, such as Food and Beverage, Personal Care, Household Goods, Health and Wellness, Electronics, Grocery, Apparel or E\-Commerce.
* Exposure to corporate transformation, performance improvement, operating model change or financial enhancement programs in a consulting or industry setting.
* Interest in developing thought leadership, new offerings and client relationships within a growing global Consumer and Retail practice.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* A graduate degree from a strong institution and 4–8 years of relevant experience, including 3–6 years of post\-MBA experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or a comparable transformation environment.
* A commercially minded Consumer and Retail problem solver who understands how industry metrics connect across growth, operations, customer experience and financial performance.
* An entrepreneurial, self\-starting approach: you are comfortable with ambiguity, require limited direction, challenge the status quo and take ownership through to measurable client outcomes.
* The communication, judgment and integrity to lead workstreams, mentor Analysts and Associates, influence senior stakeholders and deliver messages clearly even when they are difficult to hear.



  





**Why Join Us** 




 You will join a rapidly growing Consumer and Retail team where your work directly shapes high\-impact transformation programs for global clients. The role offers exposure across the full project life cycle, from market analysis and growth strategy through operational improvement and financial performance enhancement. You will work closely with Managers, Directors and senior client stakeholders in a flat structure that rewards ownership, sound judgment and practical execution. A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture gives high\-performing professionals early responsibility and the opportunity to influence both client outcomes and the growth of the practice. You will deepen your expertise across consumer products and retail subsectors while contributing to pitches, thought leadership, new offerings and capability building. The India Global Capability Center connects you to colleagues and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, creating a genuinely global platform for learning and impact. Development is supported through mentorship, formal training, performance feedback, on\-the\-job learning and internal mobility. Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits accompany a culture that values integrity, inclusion, personal growth and results.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct exposure to senior A\&M leaders, global case teams and client stakeholders, with meaningful ownership of workstreams and visible influence on transformation outcomes.
* Structured professional development through mentorship, performance feedback, formal training, on\-the\-job learning and opportunities to build expertise across Consumer and Retail sectors.
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment with competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, well\-being resources, inclusive diversity initiatives and opportunities to contribute beyond client delivery.

description:
Most finance managers gradually stop doing finance. Their calendars fill with status meetings, task chasing, and people administration while their technical skills go stale. This role takes the opposite path.
   

  

 You will run global finance operations through a team of Senior Accountants while staying close enough to the work to know whether it is actually right. You'll inspect invoices, payments, reconciliations, allocations, and other finance outputs; diagnose the accounting or process failures behind errors; and turn those findings into written coaching that prevents the same mistakes from happening again. When a critical deadline or difficult finance problem demands it, you will still be capable of getting hands\-on yourself.
   

  

 Trilogy's Central Finance team operates differently from a traditional accounting organization. We automate routine coordination and continuously look for ways AI and automation can eliminate manual work, leaving finance professionals focused on judgment, quality, and improvement. You'll get exposure to complex global finance operations while retaining the technical edge that many managers lose as they advance. If you want management responsibility without becoming a professional meeting\-attendee, this is where your accounting expertise becomes leverage.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Run day\-to\-day finance operations through Senior Accountants, continuously prioritizing work based on deadlines, business impact, dependencies, and financial risk.
* Inspect finance dashboards and completed work to ensure bills, invoices, payments, bank transactions, reconciliations, control accounts, revenue, and spend allocations are accurate and current.
* Diagnose quality failures using your own accounting expertise, identifying whether the root cause is incorrect data, system configuration, accounting treatment, or process execution.
* Write evidence\-based coaching that explains what went wrong, how to correct it, and how to prevent it from happening again.
* Identify opportunities to use AI, LLMs, and automation to eliminate manual work and improve the speed and accuracy of finance operations.


**What You Won’t Be Doing**
* Filling your week chasing status updates, assigning routine tasks, or sitting in project\-management meetings.
* Personally processing every transaction because delegating is easier than developing a strong accounting team.
* Giving generic performance feedback disconnected from actual invoices, payments, reconciliations, reports, or other finance outputs.
* Accepting recurring errors and inefficient manual processes as "just how finance works."


**Shared Services Finance Manager Key Responsibilities**
 Build a high\-performing finance operations team that consistently produces accurate, timely finance deliverables while continuously improving quality and reducing unnecessary manual work.
   

  

**Basic Requirements**
* A degree in Accounting or Finance.

title: Deputy Manager- Operations (Central Operations)
description:
**About Moove**


Moove is building the world’s largest fleet and best\-in\-class technologies that power mobility platforms. Its flagship Drive\-to\-Own (DTO) product democratizes access to vehicle ownership with a revolutionary revenue based financing model, enabling underserved mobility entrepreneurs to thrive.


Our global growth has been fueled by our partnership with Uber and backed by leading investors and lenders, including Uber, Mubadala, BlackRock, and many others. Today, Moove operates the world's largest manned \& autonomous ride\-hail fleet, with 38k\+ vehicles across 29 cities, 13 countries and 6 continents enabled by 2\.1k\+ employees – Moove continues to expand through strategic partnerships with industry leaders like Uber. We’re transforming mobility to be safer, more efficient and accessible to all, while creating economic opportunities and supporting skills development in the mobility sector.

**About the Role**


A Deputy Manager\- Operations (Central Operations) role at Moove is a pivotal position responsible for developing and building dashboards, analyzing operational data, and supporting the central operations team in optimizing processes and reporting. You will act as a core strategic partner to leadership, transforming complex operational and financial datasets into scalable business intelligence, executive insights, identify revenue leakages, and drive fleet productivity across multiple regions. The role requires a strong understanding of data analysis, excellent communication skills, and a proactive approach to problem\-solving.

**What You’ll be Doing**

* Data Analysis: Collect, analyze, and interpret large datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for operational improvement.
* Operational Support: Support the central operations team with data\-driven insights to optimize workflows, improve efficiency, and ensure compliance. KPI dashboard design, yield optimization, and cross\-functional process automation.
* Establish single\-source\-of\-truth semantic models and KPI frameworks to track fleet utilization, trip yield, driver retention, maintenance costs, and asset performance.
* Reporting: Prepare regular and ad\-hoc reports for management, highlighting key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics.
* Conduct rigorous root\-cause analyses (RCA) and deep dives into regional fleet bottlenecks, vehicle downtime, churn drivers, and revenue leakage points.
* Oversee data integrity and governance across CRM, fleet tracking, and telemetry systems to ensure accurate billing, incentive distribution, and compliance.
* Process Improvement: Collaborate with various departments to identify and implement process improvements based on data analysis.
* Data Integrity: Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of data across all systems.
* Ad\-hoc Requests: Respond to ad\-hoc data requests and provide analytical support as needed.

**What You will need for this position**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience in business analytics, operational reporting, or data science. Experience in mobility marketplaces, ride\-hailing fleets, asset finance, logistics, or quick\-commerce is highly preferred.
* Proven experience in data analysis, or a similar analytical role.
* Strong proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
* Expert\-level knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and experience with database management.
* Ability to communicate complex data insights clearly and concisely to non\- technical stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Exceptional structured thinking, numerical aptitude, and ability to break down ambiguous operational challenges into clear quantitative frameworks.
* Experience in the financial services, Internet/ E\- commerce Industry or mobility sector is a plus

**Key Metrics**

* Own processes for centrally driven exercise for existing drivers
* Churn mitigation
* Improve collections
* Own daily reconciliation of driver payment

  

**Who You'll Be Working with:**
Directly reporting to our Associate Director\- Marketplace \& Customer Acquisition, and closely working with our Operations Team.

Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like\-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach.


Moove is strongly committed to diversity within its community. The Company’s approved Employment Equity Plan and Targets will be considered as part of the recruitment process. **What We’re looking for?** 




 • 1\-3 years of experience in Growth Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Business Analytics, Product Analytics or a similar data\-driven role.
 



 • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel is a must, including working with large datasets, building analyses and deriving actionable insights.

 •

 Be part of a mission\-driven team transforming business education for the digital and AI\-first world.

With a learner\-centric philosophy, industry driven curriculum, experiential learning opportunities, and deep engagement with corporate leaders, Altera equips learners with the skills, capabilities, and mindset required to thrive in today's rapidly evolving business landscape.

As we scale into a pan\-India field\-building model in 2026, we are hiring a Manager – Financial Accounting to run the everyday execution of our finance function end\-to\-end and take full accountability for our accounting integrity, compliance, and reporting.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 This role is for someone who has moved from executing finance tasks to owning finance outcomes. You are accountable for accuracy, timeliness, and audit\-readiness across the function, not just for your own work. You run the function so the leadership can focus on strategy.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
* Full accountability for the accounting function. The accuracy of ledgers, monthly close discipline, and the integrity of every statutory and donor filing that leaves the office.
* Direct leadership of the finance team. Team leadership responsibility formalises after successful completion of probation. Once formalised, direct reports include the Assistant Manager and Senior Executive in the function, with room for the team to grow as the organisation scales.
* FCRA compliance end\-to\-end. FC\-4 filings, utilization certificates, designated bank account discipline, and adherence to non\-mixing rules across FC and non\-FC funds.
* Statutory compliance. Income Tax, TDS, GST (where applicable), PF, ESIC, and Section 12A/80G renewal filings, working with the Statutory Auditor to ensure zero compliance gaps.
* Audit management. Statutory audit, internal audit, and donor audits. You are the primary interface with auditors and keep documentation audit\-ready year\-round.
* Payroll oversight on Keka. Coordinating with HR on inputs, ensuring accurate monthly payroll disbursement, statutory deductions, and reconciliation with accounting entries in Tally.
* Financial reporting. Monthly MIS to the ED, quarterly reports to the Board, and donor\-specific reports on grant utilization, restricted fund balances, and budget variances.
* Internal controls and process design. Chart of accounts review, segregation of duties, approval workflows, and continuous strengthening of the control environment.
* Board and governance support. Preparation of finance sections of board packs, presentation of financials to the Board Finance Committee where required, and independent escalation of any material concerns to the Board Treasurer where warranted.


**Non\-negotiables**
* Ownership of outcomes, not just tasks. You are accountable for the numbers being right, whether you did the entry or your team did. You do not hide behind your team when errors surface.
* FCRA fluency. You can walk through FC\-4 preparation, UC mechanics, the designated bank account architecture, and non\-mixing rules from memory. You have personally owned FCRA compliance for at least 3\-4 years.
* Audit calm. Auditor visits are routine, not fire drills. You keep documentation audit\-ready year\-round, not only in the week\-of the audit.
* Judgment plus process. You follow documented processes and know when to escalate a deviation. You do not shortcut compliance, and you do not escalate every decision back up the chain.
* Absolute discretion. On payroll data, board conversations, related\-party disclosures, and compensation matters.


**Must\-haves**
* CA, CMA, MBA (Finance), or M.Com with a strong accounting foundation.
* Minimum 8\-10 years of accounting and finance experience, with at least 4\-5 years directly handling FCRA compliance and donor grant accounting.
* Demonstrated experience running monthly closures, managing statutory audits, and preparing board\-level financial reports.
* Expertise in knowledge of Tally (essential) and Keka payroll (or willingness to learn quickly), plus advanced Excel and Google Sheets.
* Experience leading and developing a small finance team (2\-5 people).
* Comfort presenting to senior stakeholders including the ED, Board, statutory auditors, and donor representatives.


**Advantage if You Bring**
* Prior experience in an NGO of comparable scale (50\+ staff, multiple field locations, multiple funding streams).
* Familiarity with Trust structures, and FCRA changes over the last five years.
* Exposure to donor audits from institutional funders (US, UK, EU, Indian CSR).
* Experience implementing or upgrading a finance system (chart of accounts overhaul, Tally migration, MIS build).


**Governance and Independence**
 This role carries specific independence obligations that protect you, protect the organisation, and give the Board comfort:
   

  

* You will interface directly with the Statutory Auditor on all audit findings.
* You will have a dotted line to the Board for any related\-party transactions, compensation disclosures for founding members, and any material concerns you cannot resolve with the ED.
* You are expected to escalate concerns independently where warranted. This is a feature of the role, not a failure of it.


**Growth Path**
 Manager, Grade C1 as per Protsahan’s band structure. Promotion to Senior Manager or Head of Finance is available based on sustained ownership of the function, expansion of scope, and Board endorsement. There is no minimum tenure lock. The path opens when the readiness is there.
   

  

**Employee Value Proposition**

* Gratuity (as per applicable law)
* Group Accident Insurance
* Group Medical Insurance
* 24 annual leaves apart from gazetted and national holidays
* Learning and growth opportunities
