description:
**About Enfinity Global** 




 Enfinity Global is a purpose\-driven company focused on making a positive impact on the planet by helping companies, governments, and individuals transition to a carbon\-free and sustainable economy. Founded in 2019, Enfinity develops, finances, builds, owns, and operates renewable energy and energy storage projects across the Americas, Europe, and Asia, leveraging a vertically integrated model that drives sustainable power deployment at scale. Today the company's global portfolio spans over :39 GW of renewable energy and storage projects, with a significant footprint in solar, wind, and battery energy storage systems, and has attracted multiple billions in investment to support its growth.
 



 Enfinity India is a strategic and expanding regional platform focused on utility\-scale renewable energy. The company has over 4 GW of development pipeline for solar and wind projects across several Indian states, and continues to expand its development pipeline and capital partnerships to support India's energy transition goals
 



 Enfinity has offices in the USA, Spain, Italy, UK, Netherlands, India, and Japan. Our team of over 400 Enfiniters comprises seasoned finance professionals, as well as experienced project developers and operators with extensive industry experience across all stages of the project life cycle. We pride ourselves on being creative and innovative solution providers to our customers and partners.
 



**Role Overview** 




 Enfinity India is looking for a high\-calibre finance professional to work on equity and structured capital transactions across its renewable energy platform.
 



 This role offers direct exposure to equity, structured equity, and mezzanine transactions at both asset and platform level. The selected candidate will work closely with the Head of Capital Formation, India and be actively involved in deal structuring, investor negotiations, financial modelling, and transaction closure. This is a front\-end transaction execution role in a fast\-scaling renewable energy platform.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Equity \& Structured Capital Execution** 



* Support execution of platform level and asset\-level equity raises
* Assist in structuring and evaluating transactions including: Minority / majority stake sales, Joint ventures and Structured equity\-instruments
* Mezzanine financing
* Analyze capital structure strategies to optimize return, leverage, and risk allocation



**Transaction Management** 



* Support end\-to\-end deal lifecycle: investor outreach to financial close
* Prepare teasers, Information Memoranda, management presentations, and IC materials
* Coordinate with legal, financial, tax, and technical advisors during diligence and documentation
* Support commercial negotiations and term sheet discussions
* Track transaction milestones and drive closure timelines



**Financial Modelling \& Valuation** 



* Build and manage advanced project and platform\-level financial models
* Conduct valuation analysis (DCF, IRR, sensitivity, and scenario modeling)
* Evaluate transaction accretion/dilution, LTV impact, and return profiles



**Investor Interface** 



* Engage with infrastructure funds, private equity investors, and strategic partners
* Manage data rooms Q\&A process, and investor diligence requirements
* Support relationship development with institutional capital providers


**Requirements**

**Experience (6\-7 Years)** 



* Mandatory end to end equity fundraise transaction experience
* Big 4 Advisory Transaction
* Corporate Finance in Renewable Energy / Infrastructure
* Demonstrated experience in deals execution and closures



**Technical Strength** 



* Strong corporate finance and capital structuring fundamentals
* Advanced Excel\-based financial modelling capability
* Strong valuation and investment analysis skills
* High\-quality PowerPoint and investor communication ability



**Preferred** 



* Renewable energy / infrastructure transaction exposure
* MBA (Finance) from reputed institute

**What This Role Offers** 



* Direct exposure to equity and structured capital markets
* Front\-end transaction experience in a high\-growth renewable platform

 In Enfinity Global, you will find a dynamic and supportive environment, contributing to one of the most impactful industries. We are committed to fostering your professional and personal growth while providing you the chance to make a real impact on climate change.
 



 Let's build our future together.
 



 Visit www.enfinity.global  to discover more about our culture and values.

title: Project Finance Analyst
description:
At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
   

  

 From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
   

  

 The Project Finance Analyst is responsible for supporting the financial management, reporting, forecasting, and analysis of assigned projects throughout the project lifecycle. This role partners closely with Project Managers, Project Controls, Accounting, Treasury, and Tax to ensure accurate project financial records, timely forecasts, effective cash management, contract compliance, and clear financial insights that support project execution and business decision\-making.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
* Support the financial management of assigned projects across the full project lifecycle, including project setup, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, billing, cash flow tracking, and closeout.
* Partner with Project Managers and Project Controls to monitor project performance, analyze cost trends, evaluate risks and opportunities, and provide timely financial insights to support decision\-making.
* Review contract terms to understand billing requirements, payment milestones, revenue recognition considerations, currencies, tax implications, financial instruments, and other project\-specific financial obligations.
* Prepare and maintain project forecasts, including gross profit, cost\-to\-complete, cash flow, receipts and disbursements, and variance analysis against prior forecasts, budgets, and actual results.
* Analyze project financial results and provide commentary on gross margin, forecast changes, project investment balances, receivables, contract capital, and key drivers impacting project profitability.
* Prepare project billings and support collection activities in accordance with contractual terms, working with Project Managers, Treasury, and Accounting to resolve billing or cash collection issues.
* Maintain accurate project financial records, reconcile project sub\-ledgers to the general ledger, and ensure financial system data is complete, timely, and aligned with internal controls.
* Coordinate with Treasury and Tax on project\-related cash flow, bank guarantees, letters of credit, withholding taxes, duties, tax receipts, and other domestic or international project finance matters.
* Support proposal and contract reviews by evaluating payment terms, pricing, currencies, escalation provisions, financial risk, and revenue recognition considerations.
* Recommend process improvements to strengthen reporting accuracy, forecasting discipline, project controls, and overall financial visibility across assigned projects.


**Monthly** 
**Close and Reporting** 
**Responsibilities**
* Prepare assigned projects for monthly close, ensuring project costs, billings, accruals, intercompany activity, foreign exchange adjustments, and bank transactions are recorded accurately and on time.
* Identify, prepare, and support project\-related journal entries, including accruals, warranty/client support costs, cost transfers, and other required project adjustments.
* Reconcile project financial reports, sub\-ledgers, and trial balance activity to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with accounting policies.
* Prepare monthly reporting packages and financial commentary for assigned projects, including actual\-to\-forecast variances, gross profit movement, cash flow updates, and risks or opportunities.
* Monitor intercompany balances by project and coordinate with project teams and finance stakeholders to resolve out\-of\-balance items and ensure matching activity is properly recorded.
* Ensure financial analyses and supporting documentation are uploaded to the appropriate document management systems in accordance with established deadlines and quality standards.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Master's/CMA degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field required.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in project finance, project accounting, financial analysis, cost control, contract accounting, or a related finance role.
* Experience supporting project\-based businesses, preferably in engineering, technology, energy, petrochemical, construction, EPC, or industrial services environments.
* Strong understanding of project forecasting, cost\-to\-complete analysis, gross margin analysis, cash flow forecasting, billing, accruals, and revenue recognition concepts.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and financial modeling skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights.
* Ability to partner effectively with Project Managers, Project Controls, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, and other cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Strong verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to explain financial information clearly to non\-finance stakeholders.
* High degree of professional integrity, sound judgment, attention to detail, and ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial systems; experience with JD Edwards, Hyperion, or similar ERP/EPM systems is preferred.


 Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future. We license process technologies in clean fuels, renewables, petrochemicals, polymers, gas processing and supply lifecycle services, catalysts, proprietary equipment and digitalization to customers worldwide.
   

  

**Lummus Technology is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** 
 We value diversity and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to any protected characteristic under applicable law. Applicant information will be processed in accordance with applicable privacy and data protection laws.

title: AVP FP&A
description:
****Position Title****
 AVP FP\&A
   

  

****Position Summary****
 We are looking for a highly analytical and business\-oriented Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A) professional to support strategic financial planning, business performance management, and decision support across manufacturing, project execution, and commercial operations within the Power Transmission sector.
   

  

 The role will partner closely with Business Unit Heads, Sales, Project Management, Procurement, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Corporate Finance to drive profitability, improve working capital, optimize project performance, and enhance management reporting.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should possess strong financial modeling capabilities, excellent analytical skills, and hands\-on experience in budgeting, forecasting, MIS reporting, business partnering, and ERP\-driven financial analysis.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities / Responsibilities**
**Financial Planning \& Forecasting**
* Prepare annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, and long\-range financial plans.
* Monitor business performance against budgets and forecasts, identifying key financial risks and opportunities.
* Develop financial models to support strategic initiatives, capital investments, and business growth.


**Financial \& Business Performance Analysis**
* Perform variance analysis for Revenue, Gross Margin, EBITDA, and PAT.
* Prepare Gross Margin and PAT waterfall analyses at Business Unit level.
* Analyze project profitability, cost overruns, and execution performance for transmission and distribution projects.
* Conduct order book analysis, revenue visibility, and backlog movement to support business planning.
* Monitor cash flow, working capital, receivables, inventory, and payable trends to improve cash conversion.


**Reporting \& MIS**
* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual management reports and business dashboards.
* Develop automated MIS reports using Excel, Power BI, or Tableau.
* Present key financial and operational insights to senior management.


**Business Partnering**
* Collaborate with Sales, Projects, Manufacturing, Procurement, Supply Chain, and Finance teams to support financial planning and decision\-making.
* Provide data\-driven recommendations on pricing, project margins, cost optimization, and profitability improvement.


**Financial Modeling \& Process Improvement**
* Build financial models for scenario planning, investment evaluation, pricing, and business expansion.
* Drive automation and process improvements using BI tools, Power Query, and advanced Excel.
* Ensure compliance with financial policies, internal controls, and reporting standards.


****Critical Success Factors \- Essential****
**Required Qualifications**
* CA, CMA, CFA, MBA (Finance), or equivalent professional qualification.
* 8–15 years of experience in FP\&A, Business Finance, or Commercial Finance, preferably in Power Transmission \& Distribution, EPC, Electrical Equipment Manufacturing, or Industrial Manufacturing.
* Strong understanding of P\&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, and Working Capital management.


**Required Skills**
* Financial Planning, Budgeting \& Forecasting
* Variance Analysis \& Financial Modeling
* Project and Business Unit Profitability Analysis
* Order Book \& Working Capital Analysis
* Advanced Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query, Financial Modeling)
* Power BI, Tableau, or similar BI tools
* ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, etc.)
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.


****Competencies****
 Behavioural \- Impact and Influence
   

  

 Behavioural \- Information Seeking
   

  

 Behavioural \- Initiative
   

  

 Behavioural \- Innovative Thinking
   

  

 Functional \- Financial
   

  

 Functional \- Operational
   

  

 Functional \- People
   

  

 Functional \- Strategic
   

  

**About Us**
 Sterlite is engaged in the business of manufacturing and supplying high\-performance power conductors, extra\-high voltage (EHV), high voltage (HV) and medium voltage (MV) cables and optical ground wires (OPGW), to over seventy countries. Formerly part of Sterlite Power Transmission Ltd Global Products and Services Business, the company has proven track record of being a leading cable solution provider with four state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facilities. With a strong focus on innovation and sustainability, Sterlite also possesses EPC turnkey capabilities to provide end\-to\-end integrated cables solutions to its customers. Its specialized EPC vertical provides solutions for the upgrade, uprate, and fiberization of existing transmission infrastructure projects advancing the carriage towards a green energy\-efficient future.

title: Manager/ Senior Manager- Business Finance
description:
**About Virohan:** 




 Founded about a decade ago by Kunaal Dudeja, Nalin Saluja, and Archit Jayaswal, Virohan is an
 **education–to\-industry partner** 
 building the workforce powering India’s healthcare future. We partner with universities and colleges across India to deliver industry\- aligned programs in Healthcare and management, helping students bridge the gap between education and real\-world employability. At Virohan, we believe healthcare education needs to go beyond classrooms.
 **Our model combines academic learning with hands\-on industry exposure and strong healthcare partnerships, ensuring students are prepared for real roles.** 
 Today, Virohan has trained 13,000\+ healthcare professionals, with a growing network of university and industry partners across the country.
 



 Backed by
 **global investors including Blume Ventures (India), Mynavi Corporation (Japan), Rebright Partners (Japan), Elea Foundation (Switzerland), Artha Impact (Switzerland), Bharat Inclusive Technologies Seed Fund (India), and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Venture Capital (Japan),** 
 we are building at the intersection of education and healthcare — two of India’s fastest\-growing sectors.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 We train India's next Allied Healthcare Professionals and we need someone who is a highly analytical and business\-oriented
 **Business Finance professional (Leadership Role) who treats each campus like their own company, not just a row in a spreadsheet and can drive financial performance through data\-driven insights and strategic decision\-making** 
 . This is not a traditional accounting or controllership role. This is for someone who wants to be in the room where growth, admissions, and campus operations decisions are made; bringing the financial lens that turns good intentions into profitable outcomes.
 



  





**Why This Role Exists** 




 Most finance people explain the P\&L after the quarter ends. We want someone who changes it before it does. If you've ever sat in a business meeting thinking "I could've told you that three weeks ago", this is your seat.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




 ● Run the numbers behind real campuses, enrollments, faculty costs, placements, profitability. Know them cold.
 



 ● Be in the room, not the report; sit with Business Heads and speak up before decisions are made, not just summarize them after.
 



 ● Chase the "why" behind the money; why did this channel's cost\-per\-enrollment spike? Why is one campus profitable and a near\-identical one isn't?
 



 ● Follow the cash all the way home from student loan approval to actual money in the bank.
 



 ● Build the model before anyone asks for it; forecasts, business cases, what\-ifs are rooted in real batch sizes and seat fill rates, not last year's numbers with 15% added on.
 



  





**Who You Are** 




 ● 5 to 10 years in FP\&A or business finance; bonus if it's EdTech, healthtech, FinTech, or another fast\-moving, multi\-location business
 



 ● You've worked with business teams, not just for them
 



 ● Excel/Sheets fluent; SQL or BI tools a bonus
 



 ● You can explain a complex model in one sentence a non\-finance person gets instantly
 



 ● Curious by default; you ask "why" before you build the spreadsheet
 



 ● Confident enough to challenge a decision with data, even without authority over the room
 



  





**Bonus Points.** 




 ● CA / MBA (Finance) / CFA. Startup scars preferred over big\-company polish.
 



  





**Winning Looks Like** 




 ● Six months in, a Business Head calls you before making a big call, not after. And you can point to one real number you moved.
 



  





**If you believe in making an impact on society and are keen to be a part of the fast growing healthcare education sector, we would be delighted to hear from you!**

Our clientele includes names like Assurance IQ, Inc, Booking.com, Groupon, etc. If you wish to change the game of your brand, visit us here\- https://adsparkx.com/
 



  





**Title: Finance Executive (US Accounting)** 




**Experience: 3\-4 years** 




**Location: Gurgaon** 




  





**Roles \& Responsibilities:** 




  





**QuickBooks experience is mandatory;** 
 Tally ERP knowledge is preferred.
 



  




* **Accounts Payable \& Receivable:** 
  Manage end\-to\-end AP/AR operations, including invoice processing, verification, payment coordination, vendor reconciliations, and timely ledger updates.
* **Book\-keeping \& Accounting:** 
 Maintain accurate books of accounts, record journal and provision entries, manage prepaid expenses, and ensure proper classification and documentation of financial transactions.
* **Bank \& Account Reconciliation:** 
  Perform regular bank reconciliations and account reconciliations, investigate discrepancies, and ensure all transactions are accurately reflected in the books.
* **Financial Reporting \& Analysis:** 
 Assist in preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, P\&L reports, MIS reports, and budget vs. actual variance analysis.
* **Taxation \& Statutory Compliance:** 
 Support GST filing and reconciliation, TDS calculations and compliance, and ensure timely maintenance of statutory records in accordance with applicable accounting and tax regulations.
* **Audit Support:** 
  Coordinate and assist with internal and external audits by preparing audit schedules, supporting documents, reconciliations, and required financial records.
* Expense Management: Monitor and record company expenses, review employee reimbursement and expense claims, ensure adherence to company policies, and identify potential areas for cost optimization.
* **Vendor \& Customer Accounting:** 
  Maintain accurate vendor and customer accounts, conduct periodic reconciliations, follow up on outstanding receivables/payables, and resolve accounting discrepancies.
* **Month\-End \& Year\-End Closing:** 
  Support month\-end and year\-end closing activities, including provisions, accruals, reconciliations, ledger scrutiny, and preparation of supporting schedules.
* **Accounting Software:** 
 Hands\-on experience with QuickBooks (Mandatory) and Tally ERP for accounting, bookkeeping, reconciliations, and financial reporting.



  





**Required skills \& Qualifications:** 



* Strong knowledge of accounting principles, bookkeeping, AP/AR, reconciliations, GST, and TDS.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for financial analysis, reporting, reconciliations, and data management.
* Working knowledge of MS Word and other Microsoft Office tools.
* Strong attention to detail, analytical skills, and ability to identify and resolve financial discrepancies.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple accounting activities and deadlines.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and accuracy while handling sensitive financial information.

 Minimum 12 years of experience in commercial finance, EXIM operations, FEMA compliance, and licensing.
 



  





 Strong knowledge of:
 


* Import \& Export documentation
* FEMA regulations
* RBI guidelines
* DGFT procedures
* Customs compliance
* GST related to imports/exports
* Banking documentation (LC/BG)
* Experience coordinating with customs authorities, freight forwarders, banks, and government agencies.
* Proficiency in tally, ERP systems and Microsoft Excel.
* Strong analytical, documentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

Join our collaborative and global Indirect Tax team. This role offers exposure to EMEA indirect tax compliance, tax accounting, stakeholder engagement, and process improvement initiatives. You will assist in preparing indirect tax returns, performing VAT accounting and balance sheet reconciliations, supporting tax audits and registrations, and ensuring timely completion of compliance obligations.
   

  

 You will collaborate with internal stakeholders, finance teams, and external service providers across multiple jurisdictions to gather and validate tax data. You will also contribute to process improvement initiatives, support automation opportunities, and leverage technology and AI\-enabled solutions to enhance efficiency, controls, and reporting outcomes.

* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders across teams and geographies.

**Benefits**
 At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include:
   

  

* 1 wellbeing leave day per year

title: Consultant/Senior Consultant - Finance recruitment group
description:
**Consultant / Senior Consultant – Finance Recruitment Group** 




**Experience: 2–8 years** 




**Locations: Delhi NCR \| Mumbai \| Bengaluru** 




  





*There are recruitment roles where you fill positions. And then there are search roles where you understand businesses, build markets, advise senior leaders, develop relationships and help organisations make important leadership decisions.* 




  





**We are hiring Consultants and Senior Consultants** 
 for Vahura's Finance Recruitment Group.
 



 Our team works across
 **corporates, professional services firms, financial institutions and investment platforms** 
 on finance, tax and audit leadership and specialist mandates spanning CFO and finance leadership, tax partners, Controllership, FP\&A, Treasury, Audit \& Risk, Investor Relations, Corporate Finance, M\&A, Investment Banking, Transaction Advisory, Fund \& Portfolio Operations, Finance Transformation and other specialist finance roles.
 



  





**What will you actually do?** 




  





 You will work across both sides of the market.
 



  





 You will understand an organisation, its business and the leadership problem it is trying to solve; map markets and identify high\-quality professionals; speak with and assess candidates rather than simply screen CVs; manage searches from mandate to closure; build trusted relationships with finance professionals and senior business leaders; and as you grow, originate conversations and develop client relationships of your own.
 



  





 This is a high\-ownership, client\-facing search role rather than a pure sourcing position.
 



  





**Who are we looking for?** 




  





*There are two kinds of people we would particularly like to meet.* 




  





**1\. Recruiters / search professionals** 




 You may already be working with an executive search firm, recruitment consultancy or specialist hiring business and want:
 


* greater ownership of mandates;
* stronger client interaction;
* the opportunity to build a market and relationships rather than just execute searches; and
* a clearer path towards becoming a trusted advisor to clients and professionals.



  





**2\. People looking to move into executive search** 




 You don't necessarily need to have been a recruiter.
 



  





 We would be very interested in speaking with people from B2B/enterprise sales, business development, banking, wealth/private banking, consulting, professional services, client servicing or other relationship\-led commercial roles.
 



  





 If you are good at understanding people, asking intelligent questions, building relationships, influencing decisions and chasing outcomes \- executive search may be a more natural career transition than you think.
 



  





**You will probably enjoy this role if you...** 




  




* are genuinely curious about businesses, careers and people;
* enjoy conversations and relationship building;
* communicate exceptionally well;
* have commercial instinct;
* are comfortable with targets and accountability;
* like figuring things out rather than waiting for instructions; and
* want a career where your network, judgement and market knowledge compound over time.



  





**Why Vahura?** 




  





 Vahura is India’s premier search and management consulting firm, working across legal, finance, HR, compliance, boards and other strategic governance functions.
 



  





 You will join a specialist practice where you can:
 


* work directly on meaningful finance search mandates;
* interact with CFOs, founders, investors, HR leaders and senior functional professionals;
* develop genuine expertise in a market rather than being a generalist recruiter;
* participate in both search execution and business development;
* build a strong professional network across corporate India; and
* progressively take ownership of clients, searches and eventually a market of your own.



  





**Prior finance recruitment experience is useful, but it isn't mandatory. Curiosity, communication, commercial orientation and the ability to build trusted relationships matter enormously to us.**

title: Senior Lead Finance
description:
**About Indus Action \-**
 Indus Action aims to enable over 800 million vulnerable citizens in India to move irreversibly out of extreme poverty by facilitating access to critical government support to which they are entitled. We partner with communities and governments to simplify access to education, livelihoods, healthcare and welfare, using tech and better design to navigate bureaucratic hurdles.
   

  

 By 2030, we aim to impact 30 million people with adequate social protection. Since 2013, our program innovations have impacted 2 million\+ citizens in accessing entitlements across the above workstreams. We are building a diverse, inclusive team that reflects the people we serve because real change needs every voice. Together, we’re making systems work for those who need them most.
   

  

**Position Summary\-**
 We are looking for a Senior Lead Finance who will provide strategic support to program teams in preparing and managing annual budgets with adequate controls, effective monitoring, and reporting. Senior Lead will collaborate and work alongside our existing employees and volunteers in completing the assigned tasks.
   

  

**Role and Responsibilities**
* Ensure the timeliness and accuracy of books of accounts for bookkeeping, payment, auditing, and taxation purposes.
* Closing books of accounts on monthly/quarterly basis ensuring correctness of timely accounting of all relevant transactions, provisions, pre\-paid, depreciation etc.
* Should have complete ownership of all vendor and employee related payments and ensure accuracy and timeliness of all payments.
* To monitor procedures in respect of checking and authorizing accounts for payment, as part of the finance team.
* Review monthly bank reconciliation statements of all bank accounts and update the line manager on its timely compliance.
* To receive and deal with financial queries and enquiries from departments or district offices
* To process Foreign Remittance. Coordinating with bankers for all payments.
* To ensure effective FD management from a cash flow perspective.
* Oversee administrative functions as well as facilities to ensure efficient and consistent operations as the organization scales.
* Monitor year\-end Statutory audit, Income tax Filing and periodic statutory \& legal compliances
* including FCRA returns
* Leading conversations with Banks \& Financial Institutions
* Establish / improve SOPs, Finance policies, and systems to facilitate compliance and effective management of finance function


 Requirements
   

  

**Knowledge and Technical Skills**
* Strong administrative and communication skills
* Confident, self\-driven and a team player
* Self\-motivated, and capable of working independently as well as with a team.
* Prior experience managing employee relation issues within the India country context.
* Resourceful, responsible, and self\-starting
* Ability to manage data efficiently.


**Behavioral Competencies and Values**
* Citizen\-Focused Mindset: Upholding the principle of placing the vulnerable citizen at the center of every initiative
* Entrepreneurial Energy: Showcasing ownership of time and resources to yield solutions
* Dealing with Ambiguity: Maintaining grace under pressure and showcasing a progressive approach
* Growth Mindset: Perceiving every experience as a learning curve and an opportunity for growth
* Collaboration: Cultivating productive partnerships internally and externally.


**Education and Experience \-**
 We believe that reaching our vision demands that we have the best and brightest group of leaders working to lead our organisation. Here are the minimum qualifications we look for:
   

* Minimum educational qualification is Post Graduation with 10\+ years of experience.
* Preference will be given to individuals with prior experience in the non\-profit sector


 Benefits
   

  

 Compensation:
   

 The compensation will be based on the Indus Action‘s compensation benchmarking rubric. The range of compensation will be depending on the qualifications, experience and fit to the role.
   

 The candidate would need to use his/her own laptop and the organization will bear the annual maintenance cost up to INR 12,000 per year as per actuals.
   

  

 Why work with us:
   

 Join a mission that directly impacts millions of lives across India. At our organisation, your work doesn't just improve systems; it transforms how vulnerable citizens and families access the support they deserve. You will be part of a team that has helped millions access their rightful entitlements and aims to reach 30 million people by 2030\. We offer more than just a job; we provide the opportunity to use technology and innovation as tools for social justice. Working alongside diverse communities and state governments, you will help redesign complicated processes into simple, accessible solutions that eliminate barriers to essential services. Indus Action is part of this commitment to create supportive working environments. Employees are expected to the highest standards of ethics in their professional and personal interactions. Indus Action strongly encourages applications from women, persons with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities.
   

  

 Our New Identity Towards Building Citizen\-Centric Social Protection Systems for Everyone
   

 Building Lives: How BoCW Funds Can Transform India's Construction Workers' Future
